name: Future of SaaS (SaaS Alliance)

sources.title: Homepage — rebranded as 'SaaS Alliance', membership community for SaaS professionals; blog content is largely members-only
Create & Contribute — write-for-us: pitch subject first, articles ≥800 words, royalty-free images, ≤200-char bio, no product promotion (sponsorship instead); contacts anthony@futureofsaas.io, Sophie

conditions: No product listing exists — the free route is contributing an article (or podcast guesting, event speaking, report quotes), and submissions are editorially reviewed
Contributions explicitly cannot promote your product — 'For that sort of stuff, we have sponsorship opportunities'; company exposure is limited to your bio
Much of the site's content is members-only, so even a published piece may sit behind the membership wall for some readers
requirements: Pitch the subject BEFORE writing — 'drop us a line and let us know what you want to write about'
Articles ≥800 words on SaaS topics (marketing, GTM, metrics, onboarding, customer success, SaaS+AI, funding)
Royalty-free images only; a contributor profile picture; bio ≤200 characters
Previously published pieces are acceptable — they support custom canonical links
preparation: A topic pitch aligned to their popular topics list
The 800+ word article (if past pitching stage) with properly cited links
Author contact route: message Anthony or Sophie on Slack or by email (anthony@futureofsaas.io)
workflow: Email anthony@futureofsaas.io (or Sophie) with the proposed article subject
On approval, write the piece to their rules (≥800 words, royalty-free images, cited links, no product promo)
Send the article plus profile pic and bio by email/Slack
Alternative free routes: podcast guest (anthony@futureofsaas.io), event speaking (Typeform on the page), report contribution (headshot + 200-word bio + a quote)
watchFor: This is a thought-leadership play, not a launch listing — the payoff is a byline and bio mention, not a product page
Blatant product promotion gets redirected to paid sponsorship
Syndication policy: they can reuse your content in full or in part across social/blogs/newsletters and cross-post to Medium/LinkedIn
Canonical-link support means you can republish existing posts — cheaper than writing fresh
Site reports ~20k visitors/year — modest reach for the effort
countsAsLive: The contributed article is published on futureofsaas.io under the author's contributor profile with their bio
unknowns: Editorial response rate and turnaround on subject pitches
Whether published articles are public or members-only
